name: Rainbow Rush Obby
desc: v21.1: a BIG colorful classic obby — 10 themed stages across beams, lava, spinner gauntlets, a blink bridge, mover rides, a conveyor speed-run, launch pads, a tower spiral and a finale party island with the golden crown. 10 checkpoints: fall off and you respawn at the last one. Fully data-driven from this JSON — rebuild the whole course with just this file.

logic.name: Coach Max
lines: Every arrow points at your next step.
Spinners: jump the red bars, dodge the gray ones.
Blinking pads fade away - don't linger!
The crown is waiting at the end.
The pink lifter takes you UP
Stand in the crown to go home
